name: com.usebrainchain/brainchain
title: BrainChain
description: Hire a model paid only for work that passes, and watch public changes to Robinhood Chain tokens.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays for tasks, 64 hex characters with or without 0x. Needed to post tasks, grade work and bond tasks; the server starts and reads orders without it. Use a wallet that holds only what you plan to spend.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYER_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: The path of a file holding that key, in place of BRAINCHAIN_PAYER_KEY: absolute or starting with ~/, and readable only by your account.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which BrainChain network to use: mainnet or testnet. Testnet payments use test tokens with no value.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAY_ON
environmentVariables.description: Where to pay: robinhood for USDG on Robinhood Chain (one-time Permit2 approval) or base for USDC on Base (Base Sepolia on testnet), which needs no approval.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_MAX_PRICE_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the server pays for one task or grade, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals).

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_MAX_BOND_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the server locks in one delivery bond with brainchain_bond_task, in USDG base units (6 decimals). Bonds also count against the budget and the daily limit.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_BUDGET_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the server pays in total while it runs, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals). Resets when the server restarts.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_DAILY_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the wallet pays per UTC day, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals). Kept on disk, so it holds across restarts. Unset means no daily limit.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where the daily total is kept, one file per network and wallet. Defaults to ~/.brainchain.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_MAKER_WALLETS
environmentVariables.description: More wallets for brainchain_market_maker_holdings and brainchain_token_timeline to follow beside the five they follow, as Name=0xAddress separated by commas, at most 20. Their entries carry the name and source configured; nobody checks whose wallets they are.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_WATCH_URL
environmentVariables.description: The watcher brainchain_changes, brainchain_watch and brainchain_unwatch use, such as your own brainchain-mcp watch --serve at http://127.0.0.1:8787. BrainChain's own, https://watch.usebrainchain.com, by default.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_DATASET
environmentVariables.description: Where brainchain_trace_outcomes, brainchain_token_timeline and the symbol lookup read the BrainChain MCP dataset: a directory, absolute or starting with ~/, or an https address of a published copy. BrainChain's published copy by default.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A GitHub token with no scopes. BitGo's history and the dates of Trust Wallet's and MetaMask's listings are then read with its allowance in place of the 60 requests an hour GitHub allows one IP address. Sent to api.github.com only and never logged.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_DESK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Advanced: a payment desk to use in place of the network's own. An https URL, or http on localhost or 127.0.0.1. A custom desk needs its own BRAINCHAIN_PAY_TO.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Advanced: the address the server pays in place of the network's desk. The server refuses to pay any other.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYMENT_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Advanced: the chain payments are made on, as eip155:<chain id>, in place of the one BRAINCHAIN_PAY_ON selects.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYMENT_ASSET
environmentVariables.description: Advanced: the token contract the server pays in, in place of the one BRAINCHAIN_PAY_ON selects.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYMENT_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Advanced: an http or https RPC URL for the payment chain, used to read the wallet's balance and to send the Permit2 approval.
